entities.summary:
Bongsang (b. 300 CE), a prominent economist or social scientist of the Classical era, played a pivotal role in shaping the understanding of monarchs and rulers in Global.








Bongsang's work focused on the social and economic implications of imperial power structures, influencing the development of monarchies and states across Global.








His theories on the relationship between ruling elites and their subjects continue to resonate with scholars today.








Bongsang's contributions to the field of social science remain an essential part of the Classical era's intellectual legacy.
